items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12

ctx.x: Oh there's no way to Tom's stuff. Mm-hmm. If I dig it up in his trunk. Yes. And they have one big envelope and it says do not do not open seal for court only. In case a fight would come up that he could bear it by his work.
Here's all the little loving that I had for you is gone, gone, gone. Hmm. Words by Jim Burris. Music by Chris Smith.
And Smokey Mox. I don't hold it.
